name: contact-form
title: Contact Form
description: Contact block. Black tiles, a reaching hand and a real form.
docs:
Contact Form — Black tiles, a reaching hand and a real form.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep them together in components/blocx/.
It loads its fonts with next/font, so it expects a Next.js app (App Router).
Its images are not part of this package. Copy public/blocx/contact-form/ from https://github.com/shadcn-labs/Pin-UI/tree/main/public/blocx/contact-form into your own public/ folder (1 file), or change the paths at the top of the component.
